title: Promotion Application Preview v1
summary: Add a deterministic repository-local preview that converts an exact current human-review state and promotion proposal into a non-applying proposed change set, explicit blockers, rollback references, and operator checkpoints without writing any target repository.
original_problem: RTS can generate a proposal and verify an append-only human-review ledger, but it cannot yet show exactly what an approved promotion would change before any application authority or adjacent-repository write is considered.
why_it_matters: A fail-closed application preview closes the gap between human review and later execution by exposing intended paths, expected fingerprints, prerequisites, blockers, validation steps, rollback anchors, and authority boundaries before any mutation occurs.
reason_frozen: A preview could be mistaken for approval or executable authority. A current BUILD_NOW Assessment, PASS Implementation Preflight, explicit human approval, and WIP=1 transition are required before implementation.
preserved_value: Exact proposal, review-ledger, regression, rollback, policy, and target-snapshot fingerprint linkage.
Deterministic proposed change sets with explicit preconditions, validation, stop conditions, and rollback references.
Fail-closed blocked output when approval is absent, stale, expired, conflicted, or otherwise non-current.
No target-repository write, Skill mutation, merge, deployment, publication, messaging, or external action authority.
trigger_conditions: RTS-FRZ-000007, RTS-FRZ-000008, and RTS-FRZ-000009 are COMPLETED with current governed records.
The proposal, pending review, regression result, rollback snapshot, and Human Review Ledger remain deterministically verifiable.
A preview can remain repository-local, read-only, non-applying, and explicit about every blocked or missing prerequisite.
The generated preview can be linked into the governed one-shot loop without widening authority.
negative_triggers: The preview writes, patches, commits, merges, publishes, deploys, sends, schedules, or mutates any target.
A missing, stale, expired, rejected, conflicted, or absent approval is treated as application authority.
Proposed paths escape the governed target scope or expected target fingerprints are omitted.
Rollback, validation, stop conditions, or non-authorizing status can be omitted or weakened.
Raw prompts, credentials, customer data, provider payloads, or private repository bodies are persisted.
